segment.source:
::A young woman, thin as a rail, is replanting a prickly plant into a bigger pot. Her stare is directed toward the plant, but it seems like her attention is not. One careless move is followed by a swear. She grabs her punctured finger, frowning and swearing some more, and it is at that point that she notices you.::
I'm Kimi. <end>
segment.target:

segment.source: Need some shrooms or plants?<end>
segment.target: Need some shrooms or plants?<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Show me what you have. ::Barter.::<end>
segment.target: Show me what you have. ::Barter.::<end>

segment.source: Merchants here only accept stygian coins? How do I get some of those?<end>
segment.target: Merchants here only accept stygian coins? How do I get some of those?<end>

segment.source: Look for a fellow named Colton at the docks. He can exchange currencies for ya.<end>
segment.target: Look for a fellow named Colton at the docks. He can exchange currencies for ya.<end>

segment.source: That's east of here. The docks, I mean.<end>
segment.target: That's east of here. The docks, I mean.<end>

segment.source: Would you happen to by any chance have an Armadillo class drill rotor circuit board?<end>
segment.target: Would you happen to by any chance have an Armadillo class drill rotor circuit board?<end>

segment.source: Does it look like I got one, $(#jack/sister)? I gots nothin' but plants.<end>
segment.target: Does it look like I got one, $(#jack/sister)? I gots nothin' but plants.<end>

segment.source: Ya should ask Johan about that sorta stuff. He's the guy by that pile o' junk.<end>
segment.target: Ya should ask Johan about that sorta stuff. He's the guy by that pile o' junk.<end>

segment.source: Can I ask you a few questions about Junkyard?<end>
segment.target: Can I ask you a few questions about Junkyard?<end>

segment.source: ::She shakes her head.:: No.<end>
segment.target: ::She shakes her head.:: No.<end>

segment.source: Why not?<end>
segment.target: Why not?<end>

segment.source:
::She shakes her head again. This time, however, you feel anxiety in her movement.::
Look, I ain't talkin' about nothin' but plants, dig? Either buy somethin' or get outta here.<end>
segment.target:
::She shakes her head again. This time, however, you feel anxiety in her movement.::
Look, I ain't talkin' about nothin' but plants, dig? Either buy somethin' or get outta here.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intelligence]:: Who was giving you trouble?<end>
segment.target: ::[Intelligence]:: Who was giving you trouble?<end>

segment.source: Wh-- No one-- Look, are ya tryin'...<end>
segment.target: Wh-- No one-- Look, are ya tryin'...<end>

segment.source:
::She stops speaking. Her stare drifts toward a patrolling gangster, and it doesn't take long for you to spot the connection. However, what comes next catches you by surprise: She grasps her respirator with her scraggy fingers and pulls it down to reveal mutilation. Eight or nine lacerations, maybe a week or so old, radiate away from her lips, and judging by their looks, they were made with a thick, dull blade of some kind.
A moment passes, and her respirator is back in place.::<end>

segment.source: I was talkin' about somethin' I shouldn't have. Now I ain' talkin' about nothin' anymore, so don't. Don't.<end>
segment.target: I was talkin' about somethin' I shouldn't have. Now I ain' talkin' about nothin' anymore, so don't. Don't.<end>

segment.source: What are you buyin', $(#jack/sister)?<end>
segment.target: What are you buyin', $(#jack/sister)?<end>

segment.source: ::[Persuade]:: What's going on? Is there something I can help you with? Whatever it is, it'll stay between you and me.<end>
segment.target: ::[Persuade]:: What's going on? Is there something I can help you with? Whatever it is, it'll stay between you and me.<end>

segment.source: It's nothin'-- Look, everythin's fine. Now, do you wanna...<end>
segment.target: It's nothin'-- Look, everythin's fine. Now, do you wanna...<end>

segment.source: ::She gives you an irritated look but says nothing. Instead, she just returns to her plant.::<end>
segment.target: ::She gives you an irritated look but says nothing. Instead, she just returns to her plant.::<end>

segment.source: Catch you later.<end>
segment.target: Catch you later.<end>

segment.source: Can I ask you anything at all?<end>
segment.target: Can I ask you anything at all?<end>

segment.source: Look, $(#jack/sister), do ya wanna buy somethin'? 'Cause I ain't the time for talkin'.<end>
segment.target: Look, $(#jack/sister), do ya wanna buy somethin'? 'Cause I ain't the time for talkin'.<end>

segment.source: What kinds of mushrooms and plants do you sell here?<end>
segment.target: What kinds of mushrooms and plants do you sell here?<end>

segment.source: Mindshrooms, lake shrooms, lake poppies. That sort of thing.<end>
segment.target: Mindshrooms, lake shrooms, lake poppies. That sort of thing.<end>

segment.source: What about these things, the prickly ones?<end>
segment.target: What about these things, the prickly ones?<end>

segment.source: Cacti? Those ain't for sale. I mean, they're for someone else. Should come to pick 'em up soon, I think.<end>
segment.target: Cacti? Those ain't for sale. I mean, they're for someone else. Should come to pick 'em up soon, I think.<end>

segment.source: How about flowers other than lake poppies? Got any of those?<end>
segment.target: How about flowers other than lake poppies? Got any of those?<end>

segment.source: Not at the moment. Sorry, $(#jack/sister). Ya know it's rare stuff, and besides, there ain't much demand for decorative stuff around here, 'cept maybe at the Union embassy.<end>
segment.target: Not at the moment. Sorry, $(#jack/sister). Ya know it's rare stuff, and besides, there ain't much demand for decorative stuff around here, 'cept maybe at the Union embassy.<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the embassy?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the embassy?<end>

segment.source: Ask someone else about that, or go north and see for yerself. Now, buyin' somethin' or not?<end>
segment.target: Ask someone else about that, or go north and see for yerself. Now, buyin' somethin' or not?<end>

segment.source: I'd like to ask you someting else.<end>
segment.target: I'd like to ask you someting else.<end>

segment.source: I'd rather we just trade.<end>
segment.target: I'd rather we just trade.<end>

segment.source: Excuse me, but I need someone to supply a friend of mine with certain plants and fungi. He'll even collect it himself so you won't have to go anywhere.<end>
segment.target: Excuse me, but I need someone to supply a friend of mine with certain plants and fungi. He'll even collect it himself so you won't have to go anywhere.<end>

segment.source: What does 'e need?<end>
segment.target: What does 'e need?<end>

segment.source: Mindshrooms, red dreams and lake poppies. We need lots of it. The more you can get the better.<end>
segment.target: Mindshrooms, red dreams and lake poppies. We need lots of it. The more you can get the better.<end>

segment.source:
::She pauses.::
Hmm. Sorry. I don't think I can provide ya with what ya need, $(#jack/sister). Lake poppies are easy to harvest, sure, but mindshrooms attract psi-beetles, and red dreams...that's a whole different story. Shroom pickin' is more dangerous than folks think. I don't think I can keep up with yer demands.<end>

segment.source: ::[Intelligence]:: I'll go speak to Quinton in SGS then. Maybe he can help me.<end>

segment.source: Mhm.<end>
segment.target: Mhm.<end>

segment.source: Know anyone who could help me?<end>
segment.target: Know anyone who could help me?<end>

segment.source: South Gate Station got its own hydroponics and shroom-rooms. Why not ask them?<end>
segment.target: South Gate Station got its own hydroponics and shroom-rooms. Why not ask them?<end>

segment.source: Hello. <end>
